stem: Harsh's class plans protection steps: cutting greenhouse gases, protecting habitats, using cleaner energy, and saving water. Earth's hydrosphere, biosphere, atmosphere, and geosphere are connected, so damage in one system can affect the others.

parts.text: Which claim best explains why protection needs connected actions rather than one isolated fix?

options.text: Because the Earth systems are linked, cutting gases, protecting biodiversity, using cleaner energy, and making responsible choices must work together.
Hydrosphere is the same as atmosphere, so protecting only water is enough for all systems.
Damage in one system never affects the others, so a single isolated fix always protects life.
Better protection for life appears first, and that causes people to take responsible connected actions.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Linked Earth systems mean damage spreads, so protection must address greenhouse gases, biodiversity, cleaner energy, and everyday choices together.

teacher.key_rationale: Connected Earth systems require connected protection actions. Collapsing hydrosphere into atmosphere, denying cross-system effects, or reversing protection and action order miss the hinge.
